summary.text: Alexa Avilés represents the 38th District on the New York City Council, which includes Red Hook and parts of Park Slope, Sunset Park, Borough Park, Dyker Heights, Bensonhurst and Bath Beach, and is serving her third term.
Her Council biography lists her committee memberships as Immigration, Finance, General Welfare and Economic Development, and she is vice co-chair of the Progressive Caucus.

paragraphs.text: Avilés was born in Bayamón, Puerto Rico, and grew up in East New York, Brooklyn, according to her Council biography.

She is the first in her family to attend college, graduated from Columbia University with a bachelor's degree in sociology and Latin American history, and earned a Master's in Public Administration from Baruch College.
Before her election she spent almost three decades in the not-for-profit and social justice philanthropy sectors, most recently as Program Director at the Scherman Foundation.
She served as a PTA president for nearly a decade, served on Brooklyn Community Board 7, and chaired the NYC Youth Board.
The biography says that on the Council she has passed over half a dozen bills on cruise ship pollution and truck congestion in Red Hook, NYCHA transparency and NYPD stops.
